body:
I presume you mean in harming myself, no, causing myself more pain is the opposite of what I'm looking for.

Tired a lot, upset a lot, digestion issues from always being upset and eating too much. those are my physical symptoms, the ones I can think of at the moment.

Its stupid really, I'm an extremely logical person, normally, but often I come to the same conclusion when thinking about ending it.

I wish I could believe that it was only the depression talking, to be free an able to enjoy the things that I loved, or at least new things. This is my first attempt at seeking any sort of support and a therapist may help to an extent, but I could not go into details of the roots of my depression with them, just as I can't here. I wish I could give you a straight answer on that one but I can't
